name: Clear Powder Snow — No Frost Overlay
summary: Removes the frost screen overlay so you can see clearly while freezing in powder snow.
body:
Freezing in powder snow covers your screen with a frost overlay. This pack **removes it** so you can see where you are going.

- ❄️ **No frost overlay** — full clear vision while freezing
- 🏔️ **Survive powder snow** — spot the exit and your way out
- ✅ **Works on every launcher** — just drop in `resourcepacks` and enable

---

### 🚀 Want everything in one pack?
This feature is part of **[PvP Essentials](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/pvp-essentials-crosshair-visible-ores-sword-low)** — the all-in-one pack with crosshair, visible ores, short sword, low fire and clear pumpkin.
